import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

def cry(events, **kw):
    # events: list of (list-of-A-packets) -> each packet in its own datagram at t=1
    pre = [key(0, "A", "install")]
    evs = pre + [dg(1, 1200, [p]) for p in events]
    return one(evs, **kw)

def C(off, h): return pkt("A", next(cry.counter), [F("CRYPTO", offset=off, data_hex=h)])
class Counter:
    def __iter__(self): return self
    def __next__(self):
        self.v += 1; return self.v
cry.counter = Counter(); cry.counter.v = -1

v = view(cry([C(2, "0304"), C(0, "0102")]))
print("c1", v["cr"], v["pk"])
v = view(cry([C(0, "0102"), C(1, "0203")]))
print("c2 identical-prefix", v["cr"], v["pk"])
v = view(cry([C(0, "0102"), C(1, "ff03")]))
print("c3 reject", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(cry([C(0, "0102"), C(1, "ff03")], overlap="first"))
print("c4 first", v["cr"], v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(cry([C(0, "010203"), C(0, "01ff03")], overlap="first"))

# out of order arrival: later pn processed first
